purpose: Official Alpaca Python SDK for live/historical equities data, WebSocket/SSE streaming, news, paper trading and broker adapters.
latencySuitability: HIGH with appropriate market-data entitlement and a server-side runtime
maintenance: Official active repository; pushed 2026-08-24 and repository metadata updated 2026-08-28.
docsTests: README documents REST, WebSocket and SSE clients, StockDataStream/NewsDataStream, Pydantic runtime validation, sandbox/paper environments and official docs.
securityNotes: API credentials must never be embedded in TAGX GitHub Pages/browser JavaScript. Use server-side secrets and separate paper/live credentials. Current static architecture is unsuitable for direct credentialed integration.
dataRequirements: Alpaca account/API keys and market-data entitlement; coverage/latency vary by plan/feed.
lookAheadBiasRisk: LOW for live stream when exchange/event timestamps are preserved; MEDIUM if historical backfill is merged into live state without strict event-time boundaries.
integrationPlan: Do not add production dependency. In a sandbox/private runner, benchmark StockDataStream and NewsDataStream against current Yahoo polling on feed age p50/p95, disconnect recovery, symbol coverage, premarket volume availability, trades-per-minute/turnover feature coverage, cost and false-positive/early-capture lift.
reasonForReview: Current Yahoo-derived extended-hours feed recovered freshness but often lacks independent premarket volume/turnover evidence, causing valid price-regime candidates to remain DATA-BLOCKED under V31. A true stream is a candidate solution, but credential security prevents direct GitHub Pages use.
